executionHistory.summary: No workflow phase is claimed. runSubagent was unavailable, so no specialist was dispatched and no phase-completion claim is recorded. bubbles.bug performed bug discovery, reproduction, and root-cause analysis in its own right. Verified that playwright.config.mjs declares no timeout and that the runner itself reports a 30000 ms per-test budget over 498 tests. Found 3 declarations exceeding their enclosing budget across 2 files, and refuted 3 of the 6 reported sites: simple-production-wiring.spec.mjs is reachable only from 600 s and 900 s tests, and simple-models.spec.mjs declares no budget at all. Reproduced the defect deterministically under CPU pressure, with the runner printing 'Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded' beside 'Expect toHaveAttribute with timeout 120000ms'. Established that the fix shape is existing convention at 33 setTimeout sites across 10 of 49 spec files, and designed a per-test call-graph-attributing regression guard after a file-scoped prototype was shown to red-line correct code. design.md and scopes.md were authored here rather than routed to bubbles.design and bubbles.plan because delegation was impossible; both should be reviewed by their owning specialists before scope 1 begins.
executionHistory.durationProvenance: One continuous session. Binding and static verification completed in seconds. The long poles are the three Playwright runs: 1.2m for the full contextual-tooltip file under natural load, plus two shorter pressure runs preceded by a 20 s load-settling wait each.
